intent: A ten-by-ten unit chart where each cell is one ticket in a hundred and keeps its identity, so switching periods flies the cells that change hands to their new group.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with container queries
stack.animation: motion/react: x/y percentage transforms on springs for cell flights, useAnimate for the mid-flight dip, motion values for counting figures, layoutId tab pill, variants for the staggered entrance

layout.card: bg #0b0b0c (light #ffffff), border ink/8%, radius 22px, inset top highlight, deep shadow, @container root
layout.header: title + mono subtitle, caption under it; period tabs on the right, full width in narrow containers
layout.grid: square box max 360px; each cell 10%×10%, positioned by x = col×100%, y = row×100%; gap is inner padding (default 4px); radius 3px or round
layout.fill: column by column by default (bands), or row by row
layout.body: grid left and headline + legend right from @3xl; stacked below
layout.legend: rows: swatch, label, note, delta vs previous period, count

typography.title: 15px medium tracking -0.01em
typography.subtitle: mono 11px, semantic muted ink
typography.headline: Geist 600 clamp(3.25rem, 2.2rem + 4cqi, 5.25rem) tracking -0.055em leading 0.9 in the accent
typography.legend: 13.5px labels, 12px notes in muted ink, 15px tabular counts, mono 11px deltas; labels remain readable while other cells dim

color.approach: monochrome; the first group is the one accent, the rest step down the ink
color.accent: The accent colors cells and swatches. Mix it 65% with theme ink for the headline so it remains readable in light mode.
color.ramp: color-mix of ink at 62%, 34%, 17%, 10% for groups 2–5
color.deltas: green #34d399 / rose #fb7185 in dark, #047857 / #e11d48 in light; lead group only
color.tokens: one PALETTE object per theme written to --cw-* CSS variables

motion.entrance: once at 30% in view: card lands (16px, 0.6s); title 0.06s and tabs 0.12s rise out of an 8px blur; cells pop from scale 0.4 in fill order from 0.2s at 6ms steps; headline counts up at 0.3s; legend rows at 0.38s + 50ms steps with counts rolling up out of a blur
motion.switch: groups keep their nearest cells, the surplus flies to groups that grew (nearest first), then each group takes consecutive slots in its old order; cells travel on spring 320/30 staggered 4ms per slot; cells that change group dip to 0.55 scale and back over 0.55s and cross-fade colour 120ms after setting off; counts tween 0.6s with a 3px blur
motion.hover: a cell or legend row dims the other groups to 20%; a mono readout names the hovered cell
motion.reducedMotion: cells jump, colours and counts final, 150ms fades only

interaction.tabs: 44px period buttons in a labelled group with aria-pressed; each is keyboard reachable; onPeriodChange(key)
interaction.legend: hover, focus or tap a row to isolate its group
interaction.cells: hovering a cell isolates its group and names it

responsive.container: @container queries; grid and legend side by side from @3xl, stacked below; deltas stay beside the counts at every width

accessibility: grid is role=img with every group's count in its label
Period buttons use aria-pressed inside role=group labelled Period.
legend rows are buttons with spoken labels and highlight on focus
counting figures carry an sr-only final value

content.title: Who closed the ticket
content.subtitle: Per 100 support tickets
content.groups: Resolved by the agent, Agent drafted / person sent, Handled by a person, Escalated to engineering

avoid: recolouring cells in place instead of moving them
random shuffles or all 100 cells moving at once
a pie chart beside the waffle
dataHandling: Empty groups or periods show emptyMessage. Negative and nonfinite counts become zero. All-zero periods show emptyMessage while retaining period controls. Normalize positive counts to 100 using overflow-safe largest-remainder rounding. Recreate cells when transitioning between zero and populated data; recycle removed groups when categories shrink.
